What's new

Every release of Dispatch, newest first. Dispatch updates itself, so you'll get these on your Mac within a day. Download the latest.

Dispatch 0.4.0

October 30, 2026
  • Hovercards. Rest on an avatar or a site icon to see who it is. Site cards have a Read button that shows just that site's posts.
  • Likes are stars. Just like WordPress.com, with a little celebration when you like something.
  • Comment counts in the Reader, next to the likes.
  • X-posts show up once. A post cross-posted to several P2s you follow no longer repeats.
  • Images on private P2s now load in the reader.
  • Tidier comments. Short comments get short bubbles, and Like and Reply line up with the text.
  • Restart in the ⋯ menu, and the resize grip stays under the list when the reader is open.

Dispatch 0.3.0

October 28, 2026
  • New tab names. Blogs is now Following, and P2s is now Automattic.
  • Switch tabs with the arrow keys. In the Reader, ← and → move between Following, Automattic and Saved.
  • Back to the top. Press ⌘↑, or click the ↑ button that appears beside the tabs once you've scrolled.
  • Calmer comments. The comments drawer stays put when you move between posts instead of sliding in again each time.

Dispatch 0.2.0

October 28, 2026
  • Reply from the app. Open the comments drawer to comment on a post, or press Reply under any comment. Send with ⌘↩.
  • Like comments. Every comment shows a heart and its like count.
  • Like posts. Use the heart in the reader toolbar, or press l. These are real WordPress.com likes, and liking an x-post likes the original post.
  • Starred sites are gone. They only existed inside Dispatch and were easy to confuse with likes. Saved posts are still here.
  • Comments are easier to read, with more space between lines.

Dispatch 0.1.1

October 28, 2026
  • Dispatch now updates itself. You'll get a prompt like this one whenever there's a new version.
